## What changed?

Describe the improvement in one or two sentences.

## Why is it useful?

Explain the problem this change solves or what someone can learn from it.

## How did you check it?

List the checks you actually performed and their results. For a documentation-only change, checking formatting and links is enough; do not claim tests you did not run.

## Before requesting review

- [ ] The base repository and branch are the intended destination.
- [ ] I reviewed the Files changed tab and included only the intended changes.
- [ ] I checked any Markdown or links I changed, or marked this as not applicable above.
- [ ] I did not include passwords, access tokens, or private personal information.

## Anything still pending?

Mention known limitations or questions for the maintainer. Write "None" if there are no outstanding items.
